lines.text: Jesus asks who people say He is, and the disciples name John the Baptist, Elijah, and one of the prophets.
Peter answers that Jesus is the Christ, and Jesus warns them not to tell anyone about Him.
Jesus teaches that the Son of Man must suffer, be rejected by the elders, chief priests, scribes, and be killed.
Peter takes Jesus aside to rebuke Him, and Jesus tells him, “Get behind Me, Herod!”
Jesus calls the crowd and says whoever wants to save his life will keep it.
